cards.title: Start here
cards.body:
> Free Roblox assets for developers and their AI agents.

**01 · Find your next asset**
Browse <#1566966693727699087> and follow the pack’s README.

**02 · Get settled**
Read <#1566966690649083927>, then introduce your project in <#1566964412928233636>.

**03 · Build with the community**
Share progress in <#1566970205513453709>, bring references to <#1566966905204506648>, or join a build room to screen share.

**Make it yours**
Choose optional pings and your main agent in Channels & Roles. Skip anything you do not want; you can change it later.

cards.title: Rules
cards.body:
> Keep the community useful, welcoming, and focused on making things.

**01 · Respect the people**
No harassment, hate speech, or sexual content. Critique the work, not the person.

**02 · Keep the signal clear**
No spam, unsolicited advertising, or mass mentions. Use the channel that fits your post.

**03 · Share responsibly**
Share only work and references you have permission to share. No leaked paid assets, malicious files, or requests for passwords and tokens.

**04 · Bring complete references**
UI requests need a screenshot of every frame or panel you want copied and a full walkthrough video showing interactions and animations.

**05 · Give useful feedback**
Explain what happened, what you expected, and what could improve. Keep disagreements constructive.

**06 · Follow moderation**
Follow moderator directions. Raise concerns privately with staff rather than starting an argument.

cards.title: Announcements
cards.body:
> Releases, updates, and things worth knowing.

**Choose your notifications**
UI releases · Model releases · VFX releases · Luau releases · Community updates · Events

Select your topics in **Channels & Roles**. Every ping is optional and you can change your choices at any time.

**Only the relevant ping**
Announcements use the matching topic role. Routine posts do not need everyone or here.

[Browse the repository](https://github.com/imafreakandyalldontknowit67/steal-a-template)

cards.title: The library
cards.body:
> Browse on GitHub. Build in Roblox Studio. Share what you make.

**Find a pack**
Open the [repository](https://github.com/imafreakandyalldontknowit67/steal-a-template), browse the catalog, and read the selected pack’s README.

**Install a UI kit**
Download the RBXM and drag it into Roblox Studio. Move its ScreenGui into **StarterGui** only if it landed elsewhere. Keep one copy.

**Working with an agent?**
Give it the pack link and the [installation instructions](https://github.com/imafreakandyalldontknowit67/steal-a-template/blob/main/docs/USING_WITH_AGENTS.md).

**Make it better**
Show your changes in <#1566970205513453709>. Report kit issues in <#1566966709355806911> or submit a [pull request](https://github.com/imafreakandyalldontknowit67/steal-a-template/pulls).

cards.title: What are you building?
cards.body:
**What are you working on?**
Tell us about your project, ask a question, or share something you learned.

> Work in progress is welcome. You do not need a finished game to join in.

**Build together**
Join a room under **Voice channels** to talk, screen share, or work alongside other developers.

**Keep the details together**
Post projects in <#1566970205513453709> and reproducible kit issues in <#1566966709355806911>.

cards.title: Report a kit issue
cards.body:
> A clear report makes a fix easier to reproduce and check.

**Identify the kit**
Kit name · version, release, or commit · pack/download link
No version label? Include the download date and source link.

**Show the problem**
1. Steps to reproduce
2. Expected result and actual result
3. Relevant Studio errors or logs
4. Device, viewport, and input method
5. Screenshots or video

**Add the context**
Explain your modifications and whether the issue happens in a clean place. Say “not tested” if you have not checked.

**Let your agent gather the details**
Download the attached `report-kit-issue.txt` and give it to your agent. Review the report before posting and remove secrets from logs.

requestGuide.title: How to request a UI
requestGuide.body:
> One UI per post. Show both how it looks and how it moves.

**Required references**
• A source or reference link
• A clear screenshot of every frame or panel you want copied, including important states
• A full walkthrough video showing opening, closing, hover and click feedback, scrolling, transitions, and animations

**Define the scope**
Explain what to copy, what to change, the target devices, and any behavior the video does not show.

**Before you post**
Attach the video or use a viewable link. Both screenshots and a full video are required; a still image or teaser is not enough.

Share only references you have permission to share. Do not upload paid source files. Requests are suggestions, not delivery promises.

showcaseGuide.title: Show what you made
showcaseGuide.body:
> Show the work, share the process, and help someone else improve.

**Start a project post**
Include a screenshot or video, the kit name and version, what you changed, and the feedback you want.

**Choose a stage**
Use **Work in progress** or **Released**. Keep later updates together in the same post.

**Keep feedback useful**
Be specific about what works and what could improve. Keep unrelated promotion out.
